lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Morning, Marcus. Thanks for the time. Did you get a chance to look at the interim findings?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Morning. I did. The delivery delay numbers were bigger than I expected, honestly.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, the northern route accounts for most of it. I'd like to confirm that with last quarter's data. Could you share it?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: I'll share last quarter's shipping data by Wednesday. Our analyst needs to clean up a couple of spreadsheets first.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Perfect. With that I can finish the analysis. I'll send the findings outline on Thursday so you can see the structure before the full report.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Good. My director will want to see it before the board meeting.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Understood. Also, invoice two of three goes out on Friday, as per the contract.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Sounds fine. Send it to accounts as usual.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Will do.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Actually, there's something else. The delays are making us think we might need a second phase, maybe covering the warehouse side too.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Interesting. Is that something you're considering seriously?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Maybe. I'll try to talk to my director about a second phase, but no promises. Budgets are tight this quarter.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's fair. I can prepare a short scope note if it helps, but only if you want one.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Let's wait and see how the outline lands.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay. Anything else on your side?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: No, I think we're in good shape. This has been a smooth engagement so far.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Glad to hear it. Same time next week?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Yes, same time works for me.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Great. Recap: data from you by Wednesday, outline from me on Thursday, invoice on Friday, and you may raise phase two with your director.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Yes, thanks.
